```{r doc-code, include=FALSE}
source("../code/R/doc_code.R")
```

All panels are produced by
[`script/FigureS8.R`](https://github.com/AgueroZZ/immgenT-GP-analysis/blob/main/script/FigureS8.R),
which shares its CITE-seq setup, gating logic and CD69 GP subset with
[Figure 6](Figure6.html) via `code/R/citeseq_shared_setup.R` and
`code/R/gated_protein_helpers.R`. The code below is shown for
reference (not re-executed on this page, since this script takes about a minute
to run); the images are its pre-rendered output.

## Setup

```{r figs8-setup, code=code_for("../script/FigureS8.R", "doc:setup"), eval=FALSE}
```

## (a, b) CD69-associated GPs across tissues and lineages {#figs8ab}

The ten GPs and their order are defined in `code/R/citeseq_shared_setup.R`, so
that these two panels and [Fig. 6d](Figure6.html#fig6d) -- which live in
different figures and therefore in different scripts -- cannot disagree about
which GPs they show or in what order:

```{r figs8ab-gps, code=code_for("../code/R/citeseq_shared_setup.R", "doc:cd69"), eval=FALSE}
```

```{r figs8ab-code, code=code_for("../script/FigureS8.R", "s8a"), eval=FALSE}
```

```{r figs8ab-img, echo=FALSE, out.width="49%"}
knitr::include_graphics(c("assets/FigureS8/s8a.png", "assets/FigureS8/s8b.png"))
```

::: {.figcaption}
**Extended Data Fig. 8a, b.** Mean activity of the ten CD69-associated GPs (a)
across tissues and (b) across lineages.
:::

## (c-f) Further protein-gated vs. GP-loading populations {#figs8cf}

```{r figs8cf-code, code=code_for("../script/FigureS8.R", "s8c"), eval=FALSE}
```

```{r figs8cf-img, echo=FALSE, out.width="49%"}
knitr::include_graphics(c(
  "assets/FigureS8/s8c.png", "assets/FigureS8/s8d.png",
  "assets/FigureS8/s8e.png", "assets/FigureS8/s8f.png"
))
```

::: {.figcaption}
**Extended Data Fig. 8c-f.** Examples of gating strategies used to identify
GP-active cells for (c) GP29 (CD8aa gdT or ab T cell specific), (d) GP58
(CD8-specific), (e) GP22 (DN-specific), and (f) GP68 (Treg-specific).
:::
